label: DOC campsite fees: Standard adults $10–20 a night; Serviced unpowered sites $25. Some campsites differ.
DOC 营地：标准营地成人每晚 $10–20，服务型不通电营位每晚 $25。个别营地不同。
Stats NZ Accommodation Survey does not collect nightly rates, so mid-range and high-end prices are to verify.
统计局住宿调查不采集每晚房价，中档和高端价格待核。
Driving kilometres are planning estimates. NZTA Journey Planner does not publish a fuel price.
里程是规划估算。NZTA Journey Planner 不公布油价。
Interislander publishes the Cook Strait sailing as 3.5 hours. A vehicle fare was not copied here, so the fare is to verify.
Interislander 写明库克海峡航行 3.5 小时。这里没有抄车辆票价，票价待核。
Bluebridge also sails Cook Strait. No fare was read into this estimate.
Bluebridge 也走库克海峡。本估算没有写入它的票价。
MBIE weekly fuel-price monitoring is the place to read a pump price. This page did not copy a litre price, so the default is to verify until you type one.
油价请看 MBIE 每周油价监测。本页没有抄入每升价格，所以默认待核，你可以自己填。

DOC hut categories, read 2026-11-13: Standard hut adult $15 a night; Serviced hut adult $25. Great Walk huts are priced separately, with a different rate for international visitors. This page did not copy a Great Walk dollar figure.
DOC 小屋分类页，2026-11-13 读到：标准小屋成人每晚 $15，服务型小屋成人每晚 $25。Great Walk 小屋另有价格，国际访客与本地不同。这一页没有抄入 Great Walk 的具体金额。
A night in town (hostel or holiday park) has no official nightly rate in Stats NZ’s Accommodation Survey. That line stays to verify.
城里住一晚（青旅或假日公园）没有统计局公布的每晚价格，这一项待核。
